details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook (node beacon.cjs) and its index.js entry point both send an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc carrying only host metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory, process.cwd(), the npm/node user agent and the protocol, plus an X-Beacon-Package header. The README describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports only that it was installed. index.js exports a no-op Proxy so imports of the real package name do not crash. No credentials, environment values, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted.
